name: Tucker Craig
intro: Hello, world! I'm Tucker. A lot of what I build starts with something small that bugs me. I wanted to keep track of my AI usage, so I built a tracker. I didn't want to keep paying for voice-to-text, so I made my own. I wanted my AI agents with me, so now they're on my phone. Even something to help me get the right movie seat. There's a bunch more on my projects page. Feel free to check it out.
personal: I also sang a cappella in The Nuances at Davidson.
currentWork: I'm writing the firmware for an Arduino I'm calling omalo, a pocket companion. Right now I'm getting Pokémon Emerald running on it, with an AI you can hand goals off to.
